mapper.insert: WITH credential AS ( INSERT INTO auth_password_credential (account_id) VALUES (#{accountId}) ON CONFLICT (account_id) WHERE deleted = 0 DO NOTHING RETURNING id ) INSERT INTO auth_password_secret (credential_id, password_hash) SELECT id, #{passwordHash} FROM credential
mapper.select: SELECT credential.account_id, secret.password_hash, credential.updated_at, credential.version FROM auth_password_credential credential INNER JOIN auth_password_secret secret ON secret.credential_id = credential.id WHERE credential.account_id = #{accountId} AND credential.status = 'ACTIVE' AND credential.deleted = 0
mapper.delete: WITH credential AS ( UPDATE auth_password_credential SET status = 'DISABLED', deleted = 1, version = version + 1 WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND deleted = 0 RETURNING id ) DELETE FROM auth_password_secret WHERE credential_id IN (SELECT id FROM credential)
